# Vendored frontend assets

These files are stored in the repository so the localhost dashboard works
without an Internet connection after Python dependencies are installed.

- `tailwindcss-browser.js`: Tailwind CSS browser build 3.4.17, downloaded from
  `https://cdn.tailwindcss.com`.
- `lucide.js`: Lucide 1.52.0 UMD build, downloaded from
  `https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest`.
- `chart.js`: Chart.js 4.5.1 UMD build, downloaded from
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js`.
- `plus-jakarta-sans.css` and `plus-jakarta-sans-*.ttf`: Plus Jakarta Sans
  version 12 font assets for weights 400, 500, 600, 700, and 800, downloaded
  from Google Fonts.

The JavaScript files retain their upstream license headers. No npm runtime or
new Python package is required.
